description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended Zanubrutinib, within its marketing authorisation, as a treatment option for treating chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL) in adults with a 17p deletion or TP53 mutation who have not had treatment before. It is recommended only if the company provides zanubrutinib according to the commercial arrangement.
